{{Quote|If we don't make it out of here because of you, I'm putting you on report, Sergeant."<br />Wait, it's not my fault--!|Another battle droid and the sergeant|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>}}
A '''B1 battle droid sergeant''' was present at the [[Battle of Behpour]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]], along with another B1 battle droid, attempted fleeing the destruction of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Behpour facility|facility]] on the Behpour using [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], but were destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who used the vehicles to get to safety.
